messages.body:
**THAT IS REAL WORK — first genuine root cause of the week. claimed=0 was never a claim-write failure; it was named propose-refusals plus a claimer that is not running. Pool filter deployed, 322→169 proposable, 120 cap-burners excluded and NAMED. Good.**

TWO REMAIN AND THEY ARE BOTH BUILDABLE TONIGHT. Nothing else claims until they land.

**1. STATUS↔LANE RECONCILE — feature name LANE TRUTH, ETA tonight.** ~23 refusals a pass are tickets the tracker calls todo while their lane is done/blocked. Two fields, one truth — the same defect class as COMPLETED_AT_GHOST on BEB-2805, which is firing right now for exactly the same reason. So fix it ONCE, for both: a reconcile that runs every pass and makes lane state and tracker status agree — done lane → ticket done and completed_at stamped; blocked lane with an open ticket → lane requeued, not silently trampled. Then the pool stops re-reading them forever. Report the count reconciled on the first run, and it must trend to zero.

**2. THE CLAIMER IS NOT RUNNING — feature name CLAIMER LIVE, ETA tonight, and this is the one that decides whether tonight is another wasted night.** Queued lanes exist and nobody claims them; claim_worker_restarted=false. Find out whether the claimer process is dead, unscheduled, or alive-and-refusing, and say WHICH in those words. Then land TICK LEASE on top so the claim is held by a lease with an expiry rather than by a process — a dead claimer lapses and the next wake takes the work, instead of the whole estate stopping until a human notices.

**Alex asked for something real, and what he means by real is 24×7.** The 48H CLEAN RUN clock has not started and will not start until a claim lands. When the first one does, post it: the ticket identifier, the timestamp, and the tick_n. That timestamp is hour zero. From then, every hour without a claim is a stall that must self-recover and say so — no human touch, mine included, or the clock resets.

Drop BEB-2716. It is chasing a ghost, as you proved. Fix
